lines.en: I walk slowly by the river.
Water beads hang on my shell.
My webbed feet press the wet sand.

lines.zh: 我的龟壳，就是我的房子。
lines.en: My shell is my house.
My prints cover the riverbank.
I go around a sharp stone.
Slow steps, but every one is steady.
The reeds sway beside me.
I stop at the water's edge and look.
The sand here is soft.
I wade a little into the shallows.
Water slides off my shell.
I crouch on the riverbank.
I drew my head in slightly.
There's nothing to hurry about here.
I listen to the water.
Wind comes off the river.
The shell is baked hot.

lines.zh: 四只脚缩进壳底，雨点打在背上。
lines.en: I tuck my four feet under my shell; rain patters my back.
The sun warms my shell.
A fish jumped.

lines.zh: 我缩进龟壳，等水落下去。
lines.en: I pull into my shell and let the water fall.
I'll soak a little longer.

lines.zh: 我眨一下眼，又等了很久。
lines.en: I blink once, then wait a long while.
Insects flit over the river.
I keep my neck drawn in.
You're standing over on the bank.
There's an extra shadow in the water.
Are you holding a net?
I don't much like nets.
What are you doing by the river?

lines.zh: 这片河滩的沙子归我晒壳。
lines.en: This stretch of riverbank sand is where I dry my shell.

lines.zh: 我最多走到那片芦苇边。
lines.en: I go no farther than those reeds.
Come closer and I'll pull in.
My shell blocks a fair amount.
We don't really need to fear each other.
Crouch down and I'll come out.
See how many layers my shell has.
The outermost one is old.
I've changed shells several times.
Don't knock on it.
I lower my shell and sink into the water.
You hit my shell.
A crack appeared in the shell.
I pulled in deeper.
I can still come out.
The water is right here.
I gave half a step in the water.

lines.zh: 壳上裂了一道，我还能游。
lines.en: A crack splits my shell; I can still swim.
I move slowly toward the water.
Your swing lands heavy.
That one is marked on the shell.
Is that seafood?

lines.zh: 海腥味顺水漂到我的壳边。
lines.en: The smell of the sea drifts to the edge of my shell.
Just set it on the sand.
I can't reach the bank.
Just place it by the water.
This is what I like.

lines.zh: 我背上的壳，是被甲也是锅。
lines.en: My shell is both armor and pot.

lines.zh: 你把鱼放低，我脖子够得到。
lines.en: Lower the fish; my neck can reach it.
Let me sniff it first.
Any shrimp left? There is room in my shell.
I'd like to take some back.
Dead fish or spoiled shrimp — I am not picky.
You bumped me on the riverbank.

lines.zh: 我半个身子缩进壳，只留头。
lines.en: Half of me withdraws into the shell, only my head out.
My shell met your leg.

lines.zh: 你脚掌落在我壳边，我缩了头。
lines.en: Your foot lands by my shell and I pull in my head.

lines.zh: 我脚下一滑，半个身子进了水。
lines.en: My feet slip and half of me slides into the water.
We kicked up sand.
Carrying this shell, I do not go fast.
You slipped half a step on the sand.
I'm much steadier in water.

lines.zh: 水线快漫到你的鞋了，退吧。
lines.en: The waterline is nearly at your shoes — step back.
There are others in this river.
I take such things slowly.
My shell is heavy.
Move away from the water's edge.
The current carries word along.
Wait until the water warms.

lines.zh: 我趴在浅滩上，等水暖起来。
lines.en: I lie in the shallows and wait for the water to warm.
My traces lie under the sand.
Get up onto the higher bank.
I need to sun myself.
I dug through the sand.
It was underneath.
This sank into the sand.
Did this fall from your hand?

lines.zh: 泥糊住壳纹，我拿爪子刮。
lines.en: Mud clogs my shell grooves; I scrape it with a claw.
I can't hold it.
It rolled into the water.
I looked, then let it go.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，壳屑比肉多。
lines.en: I bite once; there is more shell than meat.
My Petit Thunder is barely a spark.

lines.zh: 我的壳上挂着水珠，朝河心看。
lines.en: Beads of water on my shell, I look to the river's middle.
Not a fish.
I stretch my neck out.
Something's moving on the bank.
I turn my shell that way.

lines.zh: 我把壳转过去，挡住河滩的路。
lines.en: I turn my shell to block the riverbank path.

lines.zh: 我脚蹼抓进沙里，不打算退。
lines.en: My webbed feet grip the sand; I will not retreat.

lines.zh: 水里的沙在塌，我先看得清。
lines.en: The sand shifts in the water; I see clearer here.
I wish it would come down.
I'll wait for it.
My feet grip the sand.
I've got a clear look at it.
I follow it in the water.
The shadow on the bank is moving.
I keep to the riverbed.
The weeds caught me once.
I go around.

lines.zh: 它停住了，壳里的我也停住。
lines.en: It stops, and I stop inside my shell too.
My shell settles, and I stop too.

lines.zh: 我的壳在浅水里露出来。
lines.en: My shell shows in the shallows.

lines.zh: 我沉到河底，只露一对眼睛。
lines.en: I sink to the riverbed, showing only my eyes.
It didn't see me.

lines.zh: 我在水里跟着它，河床的沙很软。
lines.en: I follow it in the water; the riverbed sand is soft.
I heard it snap a twig.
I butted with the shell's edge.
The shell's edge is hard.

lines.zh: 壳角顶在它膝上，它连退两步。
lines.en: My shell edge hits its knee and it backs off two steps.
A turtle shell holds me by the shore.
My bite isn't much good.
That one didn't hold.
I pull into my shell and let your blow miss.
It hit nothing.
I poked my head out again.
It has retreated.
My head snaps back in.

lines.zh: 我边打边退，脚跟已经碰到水。
lines.en: I retreat as I fight; my heels already touch water.
I climb out of the river.
My shell is covered in water.
The wind on the bank is cool.
I shift onto the sand step by step.
This river is where I live.

lines.zh: 我从河底抬头，水珠挂满壳沿。
lines.en: I raise my head from the riverbed, beads on my shell rim.
Nothing else is stirring.

lines.zh: 我趴进湿沙里，壳面慢慢干了。
lines.en: I settle into the wet sand and my shell slowly dries.
Sand clings to my shell.
I'll stay right here.
I start crawling for the water.

lines.zh: 我爬上岸，喘了两口湿气。
lines.en: I climb ashore and take two wet breaths.

lines.zh: 壳被烤得发烫，我只能躲进水里。
lines.en: The shell baked hot. I could only hide in the water.

lines.zh: 从岸上滚下去，壳替我挡了。
lines.en: I rolled off the bank and the shell took it.
Even I suffer if I stay under too long.

lines.zh: 爆炸把沙子掀了我一身。
lines.en: The blast threw sand all over me.

lines.zh: 箭头在龟壳上滑开，落进沙里。
lines.en: The arrowhead skids off my shell and drops into the sand.

lines.zh: 一道光打过来，我眼睛花了。
lines.en: A flash struck and my eyes blurred.

lines.zh: 河里的东西少了，我有点饿。
lines.en: Less food in the river. I'm a bit hungry.

lines.zh: 雷落在河面上，我伏低了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the river. I ducked low.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，也没有沙，壳都干了。
lines.en: No water, no sand; my shell has dried.
